children.text: A question from the agent, in the chat panel

After t3code: the card asks one question at a time, and the composer answers it. Choices are rows with their description under them and their key on the right, 1 to 9; the picked one takes a quiet background and a check. What is typed in the composer is an answer of one's own, standing for the picked option. Its button steps to the next question, back with Previous, and sends the answers on the last one. Decline and the count sit in the card's header; the chevron folds the choices away.
